_comment: v1.2 の実スキーマに合わせて各 sql を書き換える（inspect_schema.py の出力を参照）。不要な節は削除すれば SKIPPED になる。列名は AS で正規名に揃えること。

versions.sql: SELECT id AS version_id, series_name AS series, base_date AS as_of_date, url AS source_url, sha256 AS sha256, local_path AS file_path, is_selected AS selected FROM source_versions

pairs.sql: SELECT old_version_id AS old_version, new_version_id AS new_version FROM version_pairs

rows.sql: SELECT version_id, CAST(area_code AS TEXT) AS area_code, CAST(local_code AS TEXT) AS local_code, number_area AS number_area, carrier AS carrier, status AS status FROM designation_rows

changes.sql: SELECT old_version_id AS old_version, new_version_id AS new_version, CAST(area_code AS TEXT) AS area_code, CAST(local_code AS TEXT) AS local_code FROM change_rows

fetch_log.sql: SELECT url, CAST(http_status AS TEXT) AS status FROM fetch_log
